copy.curiosityHook: What sinister force lingers within the rambling walls of the manor, and can the siblings withstand whatever is stalking them?
copy.description: In Sergio G. Sánchez's mystery thriller, a young man and his three younger siblings try to shelter together in a sprawling rural manor, only to find themselves tormented by an ominous presence.
copy.vibeSummary: Heavy, suspenseful, and steadily paced; best suited for an attentive solo watch immersed in quiet dread.
copy.whyWatch: A deliberate blend of horror, mystery, and heavy drama, this haunted-estate tale builds dread through classic suspense and protective sibling bonds.

allowedMaterial: Four siblings living together in a sprawling manor
Engaged, suspenseful, heavy solitary viewing tone
excludedMaterial: Identity or origin of the presence or intruder
Specific plot twists, reveals, or third-act events
